newsitem.title: USA: Xavier halts $100 million bond placement.
newsitem.headline: Xavier halts $100 million bond placement.

text.p: Xavier Corp said Monday it had suspended its attempt to obtain long-term financing through a $100 million 10 percent convertible bond placement in Europe.
Instead, Xavier said it will seek smaller interim private equity financing.
Xavier expects to place the equity with current interested bond investors, in order to fund winter drilling operations now under way in the Commonweath of Independent States.
Xavier said it anticipates a private placement of conventional bonds later in 1997.
Xavier is principally engaged in the acquisition and development of natural resources, primarily oil and gas, and secondarily provides services to the oil and gas industry.
